In a series of developments that highlight the evolving landscape of the aerospace industry, Antares, a notable rocket, underwent changes in its manufacturing partners. As of January 1st, 2016, Orbital Atk began manufacturing the Antares rocket, marking a significant milestone in the program. However, this partnership came to an end on January 1st, 2018, when Antares ceased to be manufactured by Orbital Atk. Meanwhile, another rocket stage, Castor, was also being manufactured by Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems, although this partnership came to a close on January 1st, 2020, when the company stopped producing the Castor rocket stage. These shifts in manufacturing partnerships reflect the dynamic nature of the industry, with companies continually adapting to new realities and opportunities.
On January 1, 2020, two significant events occurred in the field of aerospace manufacturing. Antares, a rocket, ceased to be manufactured by Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems, marking a shift in its production. Similarly, the Northrop Grumman Pegasus, another notable entity in the industry, also ended its manufacturing relationship with Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems on the same day. As a result, both the Antares rocket and the Northrop Grumman Pegasus are no longer produced by Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems, effective January 1, 2020. These changes highlight the evolving landscape of the aerospace industry, with companies continually assessing and adapting their manufacturing partnerships.

Meanwhile, Equa bank underwent a change in ownership, commencing to be owned by Raiffeisenbank on January 1st, 2021. These events highlight the dynamic nature of corporate ownership structures, with entities frequently changing hands over time.

Notable environmentalists have been recognized for their outstanding contributions to the field through various prestigious awards. On January 1, 2015, Phyllis Omido was awarded the Goldman Environmental Prize, a testament to her dedication to environmental activism. Similarly, Greta Thunberg, a prominent environmentalist, received the Rachel Carson Prize, a notable environmentalist award, on March 22nd, 2019. More recently, on January 1, 2022, David Attenborough was honored with the Champions of the Earth award, further solidifying his reputation as a champion of environmental conservation. These awards highlight the significant impact of these individuals on the environmental movement, and their work continues to inspire and influence efforts to protect the planet.
